qt: to the Commission Sander Smit (ECR) Subject:

In its answer to question P-003107/20261, the Commission states that ‘by 2027 close to 70% of OGMP 2.0 production would reach Level 5’ and would thereby satisfy the requirements of the Methane Regulation. At the same time, in Recommendation (EU) 2026/18352, the Commission recommends that Member States refrain from imposing penalties on importers until 2029 to ensure security of supply. 1.

IMEO’s OGMP 2.0 Level 5 Assessment3 indicates a share of 26% of global production by 2027 (Table 1) and approximately 60% of production by OGMP members (Figure 2). On what data and what source is the claim ‘close to 70 %’ based?

Before recommending that Member States refrain from imposing penalties, did the Commission investigate whether national authorities that refrain from imposing penalties could be required to enforce them by national courts at the request of third parties?
